get.description:
Compares skill and mood levels from the past 7 days against the prior
7-day period (or earliest available data) and returns all tracked metrics
ranked by absolute change — highlighting the ones that improved or
declined the most.

Response shape:
{
    "period": {"start": "...", "end": "..."},
    "movers": [
        {
            "type": "skill" | "mood",
            "slug": "memory",
            "name": "Memory",
            "current_level": 0.72,
            "previous_level": 0.55,
            "delta": 0.17,
            "delta_pct": 30.9,
            "direction": "up" | "down" | "stable",
            "confidence": 0.85,
            "data_points": 5
        },
        ...
    ]
}

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.
